items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I know him and I can't recall his name. Heavisett Italian fella.

ctx.x: I think Raymond's got a picture. Yeah, he oughta have. Yeah.
I know Raymond was with them and Henry. And I think, uh, I can't call this trumpet fella's name. I know him and I can't recall his name. Heavisett Italian fella. I can't think of his name.
Oh, we can ask Raymond. Uh, what about rap? Did you hear him?
